patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and Trello share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and Trello share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Hive only if your buying job matches “Work management platform with free plan (≤10 members) and Teams from $12/user/mo annual — ” rather than Trello's shape. Choose Trello only if your buying job matches “Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual.” rather than Hive's shape. Workflow advantage: Hive leans work-management; Trello leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and Trello share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Hive is Work management platform with free plan (≤10 members) and Teams from $12/user/mo annual — strong monday.com peer.; Trello is Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual..
- Workflow coverage skew: Hive-leaning work-management vs Trello-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Hive — Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams; Trello — Limited planning depth vs Work OS.

Limitations — Hive: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams; Free storage (200MB) and AI credits (1k) are tight for active teams; Trello: Limited planning depth vs Work OS; Premium needed for richer views.

Poor-fit cases: Hive is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams · Trello is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Limited planning depth vs Work OS · Avoid Hive if you actually need Trello's motion (Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual.)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
